answer: Audits are recorded in lotus, queued in marble, and pearl publishes the wait time. A farm of 130 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 12 identities per epoch. A farm of 685 identities would post 1425 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
